title: IDR Well Annotation Extension (experimental)
description: A curated subset of the Image Data Resource's well-level screen annotations: the fields that mean the same thing across studies and that people search by.

idr:plate_name.description: Plate name as IDR writes it, e.g. Plate1-Blue-A.

idr:well.description: Well as IDR writes it, e.g. A1.

idr:screen.description: Which screen of the study the annotation came from, e.g. screenA.

idr:organism.description: Organism as written, e.g. Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

idr:phenotypes.description: The non-empty Phenotype N values of the annotation row.
